figures.caption: Figure 2: Overview of the GateSID framework which consists of three components: (1) Semantic ID Construction ; (2) GatingFused Shared Attention (GFSA); (3) Gate-Regulated Contrastive Alignment (GRCA).

Table 1: The AUC(%,↑) and GAUC(%,↑) results of GateSID and baselines on popular items and new items. New items are those that have been online for fewer than 20 days. popular items are those that have been online for more than 300 days.
Table 2: The AUC(%,↑) and GAUC(%,↑) results of GateSID and baselines on all items. "w/o" is short for "without".
